bugs.reproduction: Anonymous GET of profile, annual history, quarterly history and EOD for 000725, plus profile and EOD for 600519.
bugs.expected: Backend JSON with public Company fields.
bugs.actual: HTTP 200 text/html containing the 868-byte SPA index for all six requests; no x-request-id. The same paths on server port 18000 return backend JSON.
bugs.http_and_request_id: Public: HTTP 200, no request ID. Server examples: profile 000725 request 747e392b-fad0-4635-8d4d-b4afbcce0ec5; EOD 000725 request 9479e59a-5e16-4710-94c7-8970633c91ee.
bugs.server_log_evidence: No matching structured request-id log line was emitted. Direct server API returned JSON 200.
bugs.data_source_as_of_freshness: Data exists: CNINFO profile as_of 2026-09-10; Tushare EOD as_of 2026-09-09.
bugs.root_cause_evidence: Deployed frontend/nginx.conf proxies only location ^~ /api/v1/; /api/v2 falls through location / and try_files returns index.html.
bugs.affected_users: All production clients using Company V2 through the public origin, including company page profile/history/EOD calls.
bugs.minimal_fix_module: frontend/nginx.conf API reverse-proxy locations, with public /api/v2 contract regression test.

bugs.expected: Equivalent identifiers normalize to the same Tushare security.
bugs.actual: Bare symbols are fulfilled; both suffixed symbols return HTTP 200 with fulfillment=unavailable, reason_code=DATA_NOT_AVAILABLE and as_of=null. Profile normalizes both forms successfully.
bugs.http_and_request_id: HTTP 200 server-local matrix; the later matrix response headers were not retained with IDs.
bugs.server_log_evidence: No structured request-id/provider call record was emitted for the matrix.
bugs.data_source_as_of_freshness: Bare-symbol Tushare data exists and is fulfilled as_of 2026-09-09.
bugs.root_cause_evidence: EOD endpoint normalization is inconsistent with profile endpoint normalization.
bugs.affected_users: Users or UI flows supplying canonical Tushare symbols such as 000725.SZ or 600519.SH.
bugs.minimal_fix_module: Company EOD symbol normalization and stock EOD routing matrix.

bugs.expected: Quarterly history or an explicit user-visible empty state.
bugs.actual: HTTP 200, ok=false, reason_code=DATA_NOT_AVAILABLE; all modules contain no quarterly points.
bugs.data_source_as_of_freshness: baostock, response as_of 2026-09-10; no quarterly data.
bugs.root_cause_evidence: DATABASE_DATA_GAP; no evidence that the frontend caused the empty payload.
bugs.minimal_fix_module: Company history data coverage/backfill or explicit frontend empty-state handling.

bugs.reproduction: Inspect running containers, system timers, user crontab and coverage tables.
bugs.expected: Implemented refresh/backfill jobs have observable last-run and current output.
bugs.actual: Only frontend/backend/postgres/redis containers run; no application timer or cron found. Coverage snapshots are dated 2026-07-07 and 108 missing-field rows remain pending.
bugs.server_log_evidence: No scheduler service or timer present.
bugs.data_source_as_of_freshness: coverage snapshot stale by about two months relative to audit date.
bugs.affected_users: Coverage/audit freshness and automatic repair; not evidence that on-demand EOD is stale.
bugs.minimal_fix_module: Document and deploy an approved bounded scheduler with last-success telemetry; do not run a full crawl as part of remediation.

bugs.reproduction: Inspect backend logs since current deployment.
bugs.expected: Provider completes within bounded timeout or cleanly serves cache/fallback.
bugs.actual: One BaoStock worker invocation for 000725.SZ timed out after 20.0 seconds. Profile remained available from fresh CNINFO/cache and annual history remained available.
bugs.server_log_evidence: BaoStock subprocess failed [000725.SZ] ... timed out after 20.0 seconds
bugs.data_source_as_of_freshness: CNINFO profile as_of 2026-09-10; BaoStock annual history through 2025-12-31.
bugs.affected_users: Requests requiring uncached BaoStock data may wait 20 seconds or degrade.
bugs.minimal_fix_module: BaoStock worker observability and bounded fallback; first reproduce before changing timeout.

bugs.reproduction: Issue Company requests with returned x-request-id and search backend logs for those IDs.
bugs.expected: Request ID joins browser/API evidence to backend Provider/cache/error logs.
bugs.actual: Server API emits x-request-id, but no matching request-id log line or Provider/cache call summary was found; Tushare per-endpoint success rate and latency cannot be proven from runtime telemetry.
bugs.http_and_request_id: six retained request IDs; zero matching log lines
bugs.data_source_as_of_freshness: EOD payload itself is fulfilled as_of 2026-09-09, but live-vs-cache and endpoint latency are unobservable.
bugs.root_cause_evidence: UNKNOWN; telemetry contract absent or logger level/filter excludes the events.
bugs.affected_users: Operational diagnosis, not direct data correctness.
bugs.minimal_fix_module: Request middleware and Provider/cache structured telemetry with redaction.

bugs.expected: A monitoring health path should return backend health JSON.
bugs.actual: /health returns the SPA HTML with HTTP 200; /api/v1/health returns JSON and server-local /health returns {status:ok}.
bugs.root_cause_evidence: Public reverse proxy routes /health to frontend SPA.
bugs.affected_users: Monitoring may record a false-positive frontend response as backend health.
bugs.minimal_fix_module: Public proxy health route and content-type/body assertion.

bugs.expected: One unambiguous primary source attribution contract.
bugs.actual: Top-level source=baostock while profile_source=cninfo_company_profile and source_metadata identifies both. Data is nonempty and fresh, but consumers must understand multiple source fields.
bugs.minimal_fix_module: Document or normalize profile source precedence without dropping provenance.
